card.text: TOI-1685 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-1685 b"
sources.quote: TOI-1685 b is a terrestrial super-Earth that orbits around the red dwarf star TOI-1685 which is located around 122.6 light years from Earth.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-1685. Its orbit and size follow Egger et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-1685 b"
sources.quote: It is a hot and barren planet with a mass of about 3 Earths and a radius of 1.4 Earths.
